run_ml_inference_her: run the ML inference script to predict HER voltage from computational and experimental CSV data
run_volcano_plot_pca: run the script to generate a volcano plot using PCA on adsorbate mean energies
run_parity_plot_cv: run the script with cross validation results to generate a parity plot of predicted vs experimental voltage
run_inference_with_el_features: run the ML inference script with pymatgen elemental features added to the model
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate energies per bulk material from a CSV or parquet file for inference
